review_scope: Small driver reports, existing independent raw audits, natural/priming, protocol/plan hashes, barrier and first two journal lines, CPU snapshots and stop receipts; no raw replay rerun or full raw-report parsing.
scope_limits: First orientation only; crossover and serial remain required before final conclusion.
Native is the selected strongest primary-Goodput configuration among three tested budget bundles, not all possible native tuning.
Plugin has larger pooled token-event gap P99 and slower TTFT; the benefit is fewer requests with rare large stalls, not every latency metric improving.
Three seeds share one startup per role; samples are not three independently started services.
Both CPU snapshots observe one shared cgroup; deltas must not be added or attributed per role. Windows include warmup, arrivals, drain and barrier wait, not just 120 s measurement.
No additional quota throttling observed, but this does not rule out CPU-affinity/host-memory/fabric interference. Frozen snapshots contain no per-process utime/stime.

Raw content SHA correctness is inherited from the existing independent audits and matching driver records; this small review only rechecked raw file sizes, not all large raw bytes. Unique seed/role paths and checked small-artifact hashes agree; no overwrite is indicated, but historical immutability is not provable from paths alone.
Natural exact refers to text/oracles, not token-ID or universal semantic equivalence.

Protocol load prose says seed42, while frozen plan parameters and payloads use the respective 1001/1002/1003 seed. Actual plans are authoritative; this prose mismatch does not alter executed requests.
